build_coop_mining_substrate: build the coop_mining substrate configuration with a given number of player roles
get_coop_mining_config: get the default configuration for the coop_mining level including action set and observation specs
create_avatar_object: create an avatar object for a player with a specific index and total player count
create_avatar_objects: create avatar objects for all players given the total number of players
get_action_set: get the predefined action set containing movement, turning, and mining primitive actions
